Original manifests add five isolated nodes with zero outgoing edges although actual inputs exist. Readability plus stale origin/main and registry pins is not content binding or current authority.

Do not overwrite current helpers or import old registry/manifest wholesale.

findings.location: B184 note claim_scope, N1 and next_trace_action; B186 frame description; parent B183 interaction
findings.title: The sixteen-member/minimal-frame premise is overclassified.
findings.evidence: The period-four time orbit makes some subsets represent identical averaged frames; coefficient equality w_k=w_-k is not necessary before aggregating equal orbit points. For example w0=1/2,w1=w3=1/4 closes modulo four but violates w1=w7. The chosen displayed Hmin remains a valid finite average; the claimed complete sixteen distinct frame family does not follow.
findings.minimal_correction: Retain the explicit Hmin constructor and checked closure; remove inherited completeness, distinctness and unrestricted minimality claims, or state the exact combinatorial class and quotient by coincident frames. Coordinate with review-B B09.

findings.location: B184 note 220-224, 350-361, 594, 644; primary measure slice determinants and gate G
findings.title: Intra-slice determinants are not a complete Schur-factorization certificate.
findings.evidence: det(D_t)>0 for all real m establishes invertibility of each displayed original diagonal slice block. It does not by itself establish all iterated Schur pivots, locate the full carrier kernel in a computed Schur complement, or prove a globally regular elimination. The scalar block matrix [[1,1],[1,1]] has invertible diagonal blocks and singular Schur complement.
findings.minimal_correction: Keep the exact four even-quartic slice determinant result and explicitly describe single-block inversion. Remove the uncomputed global Schur and kernel-location conclusions; alternatively supply the specific elimination identity and its actual hypotheses, without a broad new scan.

findings.location: B185 note N5 DECISION_CUT and limits; primary measure window points
findings.title: The claimed six-point/four-positive table exceeds the five computed points.
findings.evidence: The runner builds the base point, masses1/3 and2 at c5/13, and constant/alternating histories at m9/20,c3/5. It does not compute the Cartesian-product corner m1/3,c3/5. The N5 Cartesian-product statement adds that positive point. The ledger also gives a near-seam negative-start vector unlike the displayed ++++−+−+ vector.
findings.minimal_correction: State five points, three positive, with each history and mass explicit; fix the ledger near-seam sign vector to match the actual result. Preserve the unrun crosspoint as an open observation, not evidence.

findings.location: B186 note171,421-426,508 and N5 per_scope; primary F2 and no_tested_variant_is_definite
findings.title: The inertia wall contains three false ancillary assertions.
findings.evidence: There are eight disjoint four-slot cells in dimension32, not sixteen. The b8 and flat-seam Grams are zero and therefore PSD, contrary to “NO TESTED VARIANT IS POSITIVE OR POSITIVE SEMIDEFINITE”; the code only excludes positive definiteness. Finally balanced inertia need not imply trace zero: diag(2,-1) is balanced with trace1. Nonzero trace cannot exclude every trace-based explanation of inertia balance.
findings.minimal_correction: Use eight cells; say no tested positive-definite Gram, distinguishing zero PSD from indefinite cases; restrict the trace conclusion to exclusion of exact opposite-eigenvalue pairing. Keep the stronger spectral-gcd anti-commutant result at its measured fixture.

findings.location: B187 note300-379,400-420,751; primary first_failing_minor and gates D/E; downstream B188 summaries
findings.title: The determinant root and sampled failing-minor indices are promoted to an unproved positivity-boundary classification.
findings.evidence: The source explicitly leaves the seven lower minors inside the bracket uncertified, yet calls the unique B+ root the positivity-window mass edge. Endpoint signs alone do not rule out a lower-minor dip. Different first failing minors at sampled exterior points do not establish different boundary sheets, curvature, a monotone mass/shear tradeoff, or exclude a single algebraic boundary curve.
findings.minimal_correction: Retain the exact Delta8 factorization, unique simple Delta8 zero, certified positive/negative samples, local openness and non-product witness. Remove the asserted equality with the PD boundary unless the necessary lower-minor interval proof is supplied. Describe8/7/6 as sampled diagnostic indices only.

findings.location: B188 note359-367,785; N5 lattice_wide; primary gate D R1
findings.title: Reality does not make a left dressing a congruence.
findings.evidence: For real K=diag(1,-1), S=diag(1,-1), SK=I but SKS=K. Therefore “every diagonal or local left dressing” cannot be barred by Sylvester from reality alone. The source itself separately computes SK and SKS.
findings.minimal_correction: Replace the universal left-dressing theorem with the valid invertible congruence theorem T^T K T (or T† K T). Keep the actual S-sandwich and SK failure as separate finite results. Replace “not a pairing at all” with failure of the Hermitian positive-pairing requirement.

findings.location: B188 note N3/N4 mechanism,316-324 and N5; primary gate C; cache per-sector tables
findings.title: The seam formula has a phase error and the shear/zero-thickness mechanism is overstated.
findings.evidence: The actual cache prints near(-i)^p and far i^p at p1,3; the prose assigns i^p to both. The gate checks the p0 matrix and all determinants, not entrywise agreement with the claimed same-phase formula in every sector. det[[a,bω],[conj(bω),0]]=−|b|² proves indefiniteness at b≠0, but one fixture does not establish that shear is the only obstruction or that zero thickness repairs the raw Gram.
findings.minimal_correction: Write the near/far phase convention correctly (or display an explicit basis change), retain the determinant and measured inertia result, and mark shear attribution/zero-thickness repair unproved. No new all-parameter experiment is needed to narrow this claim.

findings.location: B188 note712-733; primary gate G triangle invariant; next_trace_action
findings.title: The triangle invariant excludes only fixed-basis diagonal congruence.
findings.evidence: For nonsingular real diagonal E the product scales by (E0 E1 E4)^2; opposite signs exclude this class. It does not exclude arbitrary gauge maps, relabelings or general congruence. Any two SPD matrices are congruent: with T=A^(-1/2)B^(1/2), T^T A T=B.
findings.minimal_correction: Keep unequal and not diagonally congruent in the displayed indexing. Remove “not gauge copies” or define and justify a strictly diagonal allowed gauge group. Physical inequivalence remains open.

findings.location: B188 note235-236 (N2 T4), b188_check_findings.md B9, missing campaign/b186 findings citations
findings.title: Historical diagnostic evidence needs explicit recovery and disposition.
findings.evidence: The claimed16-dimensional companion census3 positive+3 negative+1 zero+9 complex is not produced by the primary and its campaign supplier is missing; nine nonreal roots is impossible for a real characteristic polynomial. The preserved B188 check sidecar also reports an open-half alternative with changed D/Q but positive finite Grams; retaining only the fixed-edge no-op part would lose that science. B187 additionally labels four masses/two corners as checker-cited, not fresh primary measurements.
findings.minimal_correction: Preserve all original sidecar and historical diagnostic bodies. Demote unavailable assertions to unverified historical observations, flag the companion census inconsistency, and retain B9 open-half success as historical alternative evidence without adopting uniqueness. Separate primary-reproduced from merely cited samples.
